historicalAliases.notes: Used from Connor's first appearance (episode-022) through the 2026-12-20 to 2027-01-03 institutional break. Replaced by SullCon effective 2027-01-04, per episode-093; SullCon condenses Connor Sullivan into a single nickname.

individualTimeline: Episode 22: Mako first appears during cross-roster training after the Korean bootcamp.
Episode 93: Returning from the 2026-12-20 to 2027-01-03 institutional break, Connor's updated nickname (SullCon, replacing Mako) becomes current.
Episode 116 (2027-01-28): Works off-comfort champions chosen from 2027 preparation trends with the League staff.
Episode 118 (2027-01-29): Plays five full private scrims on five champions outside the usual pool against an independent team; the results are practice only.
Episode 121 (2027-02-01): Academy Blue lose 1-2 to Blue Otter in a private MD3; Connor admits he cost game 3.
